raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
Worked at STARLITE INFOTECH LIMITED from JUN 2023 to JAN 2026 • Worked at CAPGEMINI INDIA from JUL 2021 to JUN 2023 • Worked at ZEEL CODE LABS as an Intern from JUNE 2020 to MAY 2021
STARLITE INFOTECH LIMITED (June 2023 – Jan 2026)
Worked as a leveraging the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power
BI, Dataverse).
Currently leading cross-functional teams, defining governance and ALM processes, and integrating with Microsoft 365/Azure ecosystems to drive digital transformation and business process automation.
1.Project: Document Translation Model
Technologies: Power Apps, Power Automate and Azure Cognitive Services
Project Description:
Built a document-translation solution using Power Apps as the front end, Power Automate for orchestration, and Azure Cognitive Services Document Translation to translate documents across multiple languages while preserving layout and format
Enabled business users to upload documents via Power Apps, triggered translation through
automation workflows, logged metadata in Dataverse, and reduced manual effort
2.Project: Expense Management system
Technologies: Power Apps, Power Automate and Azure AI Foundry
Project Description:
Developed an Expense Management System where users upload receipts and invoices via a
Power Apps interface
• Leveraged Azure AI Foundry (including GPT-based models) to automatically extract key data
from documents, and orchestrated the workflow with Power Automate.
Built an approver layer where assigned reviewers could view the
extracted data, approve or reject it, after which it was forwarded to the finance team for
final processing.
3.Project: Project Transfer Form Automation
Technologies: Power Apps, Power Automate and Azure AI Foundry
Project Description:
Built a sequential multi-stage approval workflow in Power Automate (from approver to
approver) and implemented reminders for any outstanding approvals.
Once all approvers approved, the system generated a PDF and sent it to the uploader; if any
approver rejected, the uploader received an email with comments.
CAPGEMINI INDIA (JUL 2021 to JUN 2023)
Worked as a Power Platform Analyst on various tools on Power Platform like Power BI,
Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Virtual Agents, Dataverse and AI-Builder.
Created 120 Power Automate Cloud Flows,10 PowerApps Canvas Application, 2 Model
Driven Apps, 8 Power BI Dashboards and 2 Power Virtual Agent Chatbot.
1.Project: RES Plus Rock Heroes - Monthly Voting
Technologies: PowerApps and Power Automate
Project Description:
This Power App allows monthly recognition of associates by their managers, with each
manager limited to one vote per associate per month.
A Power Automate Flow captures responses from a Nomination Microsoft Form and inserts
them into a SharePoint list for managers to vote for their associates.
2.Project: RH Optimization
Technologies: Power BI, PowerApps, Power Automate and Dataverse
Project Description:
This Power App allows monthly recognition of associates by their managers, with each
manager limited to one vote per associate per month.
A Power Automate Flow captures responses from a Nomination Microsoft Form and inserts
them into a SharePoint list for managers to vote for their associates.
3.Project: Send Qualtrics Response to Monday for Software and Services Survey
Technologies: Power Automate
Project Description:
The Power Automate flow will connect Qualtrics surveys - that are sent by GDM BD/AM reps to vendors when they are interested Gartner’s Landing Page (LP) service - to Monday.com´s Marketing Services Team workspace.
ZEEL CODE LABS (JUNE 2020 - MAY 2021)
Project Title: Employee Request & Approval Management System Technologies: Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint
Description: Designed and developed a Canvas App to manage employee service requests such as leave applications, asset requests, and approvals. Integrated the application with SharePoint and Dataverse for centralized data storage. Implemented automated approval workflows using Power Automate with email and Teams notifications. Enhanced user experience by creating responsive UI screens and validation logic using Power Fx.
